description: A planner splits a goal into tasks, each task is built and checked on its own branch of a stack, and a reviewer reads the result.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves each task, for example the tests.

nodes.label: Plan
nodes.prompt:
Plan this goal for the repository of your working directory. Read the code first; do not change it.

The goal:

{{goal}}

The person answered your earlier question (empty when you did not ask one):

{{clarify.note}}

Split the goal into small tasks that an agent can each build and test in under an hour. Give each task a short `id` (lowercase, for example `t1`), a `title`, the `details` the builder needs (files, behaviour, how to test it), and `dependsOn`: the ids of the tasks it builds on. Order them so a task comes after the tasks it depends on.

Report `planned` with the tasks. When the goal is too unclear to plan, report `unclear` with an empty task list, and put your question in the summary.

outcomes.name: planned
outcomes.description: The tasks are in the data.

outcomes.name: unclear
outcomes.description: The goal needs an answer from the person first; the question is in the summary.

nodes.label: Ask the person

options.name: answered
options.description: The note holds the answer; the planner tries again.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.prompt:
Review the work of an unattended run in the repository of your working directory. Do not change the code.

The goal:

{{goal}}

The tasks and how they ended:

{{build.summary}}

Read the changes since `{{run.base_ref}}` (for example `git log {{run.base_ref}}..HEAD` and `git diff {{run.base_ref}}...HEAD`). Check that they reach the goal, are tested, and do not break anything.

Report `approved` when the work is ready to merge, else `changes-requested`. List each problem in `issues`, one short sentence each (an empty list when there are none).

outcomes.name: changes-requested
outcomes.description: The issues must be fixed first.
